original_nasdaq_rationale: Scheduled U.S. data creates a pre-cash-open NQ move that practitioners may label manipulation.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: NQ prices anticipated equity cash-open repricing and index constituents.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Treat 08:30 as an event-time gold information shock, conditional on release category and standardized surprise.
supporting_evidence: S01-S03, S12-S15 show formal release timing and strong gold announcement effects.
contradicting_evidence: S14 finds many releases have no detectable metal effect; S21 shows very rapid efficient adjustment in other futures.
recommended_test: Compare 08:30-08:35 absolute return and range on major, minor and no-release days; regress on standardized surprise.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Calling the move manipulation prejudges reversal and ignores efficient price discovery.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Opening auction and cash/index arbitrage concentrate equity information and volume.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Formal Nasdaq/NYSE 09:30 auction, constituent openings, cash-futures basis and ETF creation/redemption.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Potential cross-asset risk-sentiment or portfolio-rebalancing impulse in gold, tested after controlling for 08:30.
supporting_evidence: S07-S08 establish the auction; S18 supports a gold response to extreme equity shocks.
contradicting_evidence: S09 and S16 show gold already trades and discovers price before 09:30; no controlled XAUUSD 09:30 edge was found.
recommended_test: Estimate incremental 09:30 volatility/return with day fixed effects or matched controls including 08:30 impulse, news category and surprise.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Mistakes an equity-specific institutional open for a gold session open.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Community reference to the open of the 10:00 candle after initial equity-open volatility.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: No formal Nasdaq/NYSE session begins at 10:00; often tied to index-trader routines.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Use as a secondary event window and explicitly flag scheduled 10:00 releases.
supporting_evidence: S03-S05 show real 10:00 releases; S12 finds some 10:00 news effects; S30-S31 document the community heuristic.
contradicting_evidence: No exchange source recognizes a 10:00 market open; S30-S31 provide no empirical proof.
recommended_test: Compare 10:00-10:30 on 10:00-release versus non-release days and test whether any residual clock effect remains.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Attributes macro-release repricing to a chart candle or community key-open narrative.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Cash-open volume may breach pre-market or 08:30 extremes before reversing.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Cash-auction order imbalances and index arbitrage.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Observable breach-and-reentry of the 08:30 impulse extreme or pre-news range after 09:30.
supporting_evidence: S24-S25 describe the practitioner pattern; S18 supports a conditional equity-to-gold channel.
contradicting_evidence: S19 shows stop clusters can propagate continuation; S34 reports null results for OHLCV liquidity-grab families in MNQ.
recommended_test: Compare post-09:30 breach/reentry outcomes with matched accepted breakouts, separately on news and non-news days.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Sweep labels can be assigned with hindsight and do not reveal order intent.

original_nasdaq_rationale: An opening false move against a presumed daily bias precedes the 'real' direction.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Kill-zone conventions and cash-open narrative are commonly derived from index/FX education.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Rename as a deterministic false-breakout-and-reversal outcome; do not encode intent.
supporting_evidence: S29 and S25 document the practitioner hypothesis.
contradicting_evidence: S12-S13 support fast news price discovery; S19 supports continuation cascades; no gold-specific Judas study found.
recommended_test: Test breach, close-back and MSS rules with causal confirmation; compare to all breakouts.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Bias and 'real direction' can be hindsight labels; high multiple-testing risk.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Stops are assumed to cluster beyond session/swing extremes and the breach supplies liquidity.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Reference levels often use overnight, pre-market and RTH structures specific to index futures.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Cross of a predeclared gold range/swing followed by a close back within a fixed number of bars.
supporting_evidence: S19 supports order clustering/cascades in FX; S32 supplies programmable practitioner geometry.
contradicting_evidence: S19 finds continuation after stop clusters, contradicting automatic-reversal claims; no XAU order-book proof.
recommended_test: Test reversal and continuation conditional on breach size, close-back speed, news and surprise.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Retail XAUUSD is fragmented OTC/CFD; actual stops and centralized volume are unobserved.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Large directional candle indicates aggressive repricing and validates MSS/FVG.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: None in geometry, though typical size thresholds depend on NQ volatility and tick value.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Candle body/range standardized by rolling same-time gold volatility, close location and optional FVG.
supporting_evidence: S12-S15 support unusually large event-time gold moves; S33 captures practitioner use.
contradicting_evidence: Large bars can be public-news price discovery rather than institutional directional commitment.
recommended_test: Sensitivity over body/median and true-range/ATR thresholds; evaluate forward returns without conditioning on future bars.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Absolute-point rules fail across gold price and volatility regimes.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Post-sweep body close through a confirmed swing signals reversal.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Swing scale calibrated to NQ's microstructure and chosen chart timeframe.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Causal break of the most recent confirmed 1-minute or 3-minute pivot with displacement.
supporting_evidence: S33 provides practitioner definition; deterministic swing logic is implementable.
contradicting_evidence: No independent evidence that this pattern has gold expectancy; pivot confirmation introduces delay.
recommended_test: Compare 1-minute and 3-minute MSS; vary pivot width and displacement filter.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Using future bars to identify pivots causes look-ahead; loose swing selection creates researcher discretion.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Three-candle wick non-overlap marks a fast NQ delivery zone and potential retracement entry.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: No formal dependency, but frequency and tick size are instrument/timeframe specific.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Identical three-bar gap geometry on gold, treated only as a bar pattern.
supporting_evidence: S26 defines reproducible geometry; S13 documents fast event moves and wider spreads.
contradicting_evidence: No independent evidence that the zone is 'fair value' or must fill; gaps may be microstructure artifacts.
recommended_test: Test first proximal, midpoint and distal touch after causal creation, net of event-time costs.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Semantic institutional claims and fill expectation may not transfer; bid/ask gaps differ from OHLC gaps.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Wick at an index liquidity level is treated as a future entry zone.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Often selected using discretionary RTH highs/lows and visible chart narrative.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Mechanically define body-to-wick zone on a sweep/reentry candle with a minimum wick fraction.
contradicting_evidence: No Tier 1/2 validation; competing definitions select one or multiple candles.
recommended_test: Include only as a separately labeled experimental geometry with predeclared wick and pivot rules.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: High degrees of freedom and hindsight candle selection.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Deep 62%-79% retracement of an NQ impulse is claimed to offer favorable risk/reward.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: None formal, but impulse anchoring is discretionary and NQ-specific examples dominate.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Fixed 62%-79% retracement of the objectively defined 08:30 impulse, plus 50%, 62% and 75% single levels.
supporting_evidence: S27 documents the exact practitioner zone.
contradicting_evidence: No empirical source establishes privileged Fibonacci ratios; simple retracement is the appropriate benchmark.
recommended_test: Compare all predeclared depths on identical event cohorts and report fill/expiry/cost trade-offs.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Anchor selection and multiple depths invite data mining; deep entries may never fill.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Holding above/below pre-market range suggests genuine index breakout rather than manipulation.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Pre-market range is closely tied to RTH transition.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Two consecutive 1-minute closes or one 3-minute close beyond a buffered pre-news boundary.
supporting_evidence: S19 supports persistent/cascade behavior after levels; market-auction logic makes acceptance a neutral construct.
contradicting_evidence: Threshold is a research proxy, not a named empirical gold fact.
recommended_test: Vary close count, time allowance and volatility buffer; compare continuation rates.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Long confirmation delays entries and can re-label the same path under different bar aggregation.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Return inside the pre-market range signals failed breakout and potential reversal.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Nasdaq pre-market boundaries are equity-session specific.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: First causal close back inside the 07:30-08:29 or 08:00-08:29 gold range after a breach.
supporting_evidence: S32 matches practitioner geometry; S14 shows heterogeneous news reaction that makes failure plausible.
contradicting_evidence: S19 shows breaches near stops may continue rather than re-enter.
recommended_test: Estimate full-reversal probability versus accepted breakout baseline by news class.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Using wick-only reentry or unrestricted time makes the rule hindsight-prone.

original_nasdaq_rationale: NQ holding the news impulse equilibrium until cash open is treated as continuation evidence.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Whether all closes or a required fraction of closes remain on the impulse-direction side of 50% through 09:29.
supporting_evidence: A neutral measurable state; consistent with continuation hypotheses from S19.
contradicting_evidence: No source validates 50% as a privileged threshold.
recommended_test: Test 50%, 62% and time-weighted hold fractions; report monotonicity rather than best-only threshold.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Threshold optimization can manufacture an apparent edge.

original_nasdaq_rationale: First RTH move is assumed to trap traders before reversal.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Requires the 09:30 cash opening auction and constituent order imbalance.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Do not transfer the manipulation label; test only 09:30 false breakout on non-news gold days.
contradicting_evidence: S20 supports efficient opening price discovery; S34 finds no robust MNQ OHLCV family after costs.
recommended_test: Retain only the observable non-news false-breakout family as exploratory, with no intent claim.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Direct copying imports equity-auction mechanics and hindsight narrative into gold.

original_nasdaq_rationale: NQ/FX New York setups often use overnight/London extremes as stop/liquidity references.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Practitioner London window conventions and daylight-saving mismatch.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Gold London-session high/low using an explicit Europe/London clock, plus ET-window sensitivity.
supporting_evidence: S11 and S16 establish London as an important gold center; S29 uses London extremes in the framework.
contradicting_evidence: A single retail XAU feed may not represent London OTC price/volume; session boundary is not unique.
recommended_test: Compare actual London-clock and fixed-ET definitions; predeclare one primary.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: DST mismatch and feed-specific Sunday/daily maintenance bars can shift extremes.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Widely watched RTH liquidity levels for index futures.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: RTH versus full-session day is meaningful and market-specific.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Prior complete New York trading-day high/low and, separately, prior COMEX session high/low.
supporting_evidence: Generic observable reference; no strong source-specific performance claim.
contradicting_evidence: No empirical evidence here that gold reverses at these levels.
recommended_test: Test prior NY calendar day and prior COMEX trade-date definitions separately.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Ambiguous day boundary in 23-hour gold trading and broker maintenance windows.

original_nasdaq_rationale: NQ direction is aligned with equity structure and index liquidity targets.
nasdaq_specific_dependency: Equity-index constituents, earnings and cash breadth.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Causal gold bias using prior daily trend plus contemporaneous but lagged USD/real-yield/risk variables when available.
supporting_evidence: S18, S22 and S23 support equity-risk, real-yield and dollar channels.
contradicting_evidence: Relationships are state-dependent and often low-frequency; fixed signs may fail.
recommended_test: Report alignment using a predeclared, lagged bias and compare unfiltered results; never infer bias from future session path.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Adding many macro filters increases overfit and may require unavailable high-frequency instruments.

original_nasdaq_rationale: Accumulation-manipulation-distribution narrates the NQ day around pre-market and cash open.
possible_xauusd_equivalent: Replace intent labels with mutually exclusive path states based on breach, reentry, retracement and extension.
contradicting_evidence: No independent evidence of deterministic institutional sequencing; overlapping states can be assigned with hindsight.
recommended_test: Classify outcomes for reporting only; strategy signals may use only information available by entry time.
risks_of_direct_transplantation: Using final lifecycle as an entry filter is direct look-ahead bias.
